annotations.text:
Accounts lead, per PRD §8.

The date control sits BELOW them on purpose: balances are never range-scoped, so a picker above them would imply it scopes everything.

The inline form is gone.

"Add another line" keeps batch entry first-class — PRD §1 calls lump-sum entry a first-class flow, not an afterthought.

The PIN row renders and does nothing.

Dashed border, muted, "Not set up". No code path touches pin_hash until the security milestone.

Spend by category is ONE measure, so the bars are one hue and rank carries the meaning. Accent marks only the drilled-into bar.

The trend line moved to teal so it can't be read as the brand colour.
Settled: Instrument Serif for headings, Geist for everything operational. Newsreader is gone so this reads as a decision, not an open question.
